note: Every entry here is a test that RUNS, is GREEN, and cannot fail. Registration is not absolution: it records who owns the gap. Ratchets may only go DOWN. Do not add an entry to make a red gate green — give the test a real assertion instead. Suppressed tests (it.skip/it.todo/xit) are NOT this gate's business; they live in test-suppressions.json.

allowed.title: processes insight for the owning org when found (isolation — control returns or calls AI)
allowed.reason: Inventory is excluded from the 10/10 release (accepted residual R-9, owner: CRM/inventory release owner, review 2026-12-01). Repairing it means editing a module this release does not cover. The test calls the service and ends; it asserts nothing about the org boundary its title claims.

allowed.title: 11. Manager scope is non-all DataScope (contract): self-only not all
allowed.reason: Scenarios 5 and 6 in this file were converted from expect(true).toBe(true) to real schema assertions. This one cannot follow them: it asserts a scope GRANTED TO A ROLE rather than a flag on a permission definition, so it needs the access layer's role fixtures rather than a table config read. Owner: payroll/RBAC. Unlike its siblings it names no index or catalog symbol to read.

allowed.title: PRODUCT-BLOCKED — no operator access mechanism: this spec documents the gap
allowed.reason: Deliberate: there is no operator-access mechanism to test, and the spec exists to keep the absence visible. Already recorded against ticket 35 box 8. It becomes a real test the moment an operator-access mechanism exists, and this registration is what will make that visible.

allowed.title: is higher than the raw declared limit outside production (DEV_LIMIT_MULTIPLIER)
allowed.reason: ENVIRONMENT guard: the assertion is about the DEV multiplier and is meaningless under NODE_ENV=production, where the multiplier is 1. The guard names the environment, not whether a double was reached. Owner: platform.

allowed.title: %s: non-public controllers gate on @RequireModule('surveys') at class level
allowed.reason: DOMAIN guard inside an it.each over every controller: a wholly @Public() controller has no module gate to assert, so that case exempts itself. Real risk, recorded rather than waved away: if isClassPublic ever became true for every controller the whole suite would pass vacuously, and nothing asserts the exemption count. Owner: surveys.

allowed.title: %s: every non-public controller gates on @RequireModule('timesheets') at class level
allowed.reason: DOMAIN guard inside an it.each over every controller, same shape and same recorded risk as the surveys module-gate spec: a wholly @Public() controller exempts its own case, and the exemption count is not asserted. Owner: timesheets.
